senses.gloss: f. (from its shape, v. <cite ref="A00568">foreg.</cite> a. P. Sm. 40)

units: Y. Maas. Sh. IV, 55ᵇ bot. (to one who had dreamt he had four udnin = ears, v. foreg.) מלוי את תרתי אֻדְנָיךְ ותרתי אוּדְנוֹי דגרבא thou shalt have wine enough to fill thy own two udnin (wine jars), and two udnin (measures) of a garba (v. גַּרְבָּא I) besides.
Ber. 22ᵃ was sitting בא׳ דמיא Ar. (ed. באגנא, Ms. Beth. Nath. באוזנא) in a tub filled with an udna of water.
<cite ref="Shabbat 157b">Sabb. 157ᵇ</cite> <he>א׳ דמיא</he> … Ar. (ed. <he>באוונא</he>, Ms. M. <he>אַדָּנָא</he>) by a bath-tub.
